mapper.sql: r.id, r.application_id, r.member_id, r.copy_id, r.borrowed_at, r.due_at, r.returned_at, r.status, r.overdue_days, r.approved_by, r.returned_by, r.return_condition_note, r.return_outcome, r.renew_count, r.last_renewed_at, r.version, r.created_at, r.updated_at
mapper.select: select count(*) from borrow_record where copy_id = #{copyId} and status in ('BORROWING', 'OVERDUE') and returned_at is null
select from borrow_record r where r.copy_id = #{copyId} and r.status in ('BORROWING', 'OVERDUE') and r.returned_at is null order by r.id desc limit 1

select count(*) from borrow_record r join book_copy bc on bc.id = r.copy_id where r.member_id = #{memberId} and bc.book_id = #{bookId} and r.status in ('BORROWING', 'OVERDUE') and r.returned_at is null
mapper.insert: insert into borrow_record(application_id, member_id, copy_id, borrowed_at, due_at, status, overdue_days, approved_by, renew_count, version) values(#{applicationId}, #{memberId}, #{copyId}, #{borrowedAt}, #{dueAt}, #{status}, #{overdueDays}, #{approvedBy}, coalesce(#{renewCount}, 0), #{version})
mapper.update: update borrow_record set returned_at = #{now}, status = #{status}, return_outcome = #{returnOutcome}, overdue_days = #{overdueDays}, returned_by = #{returnedBy}, return_condition_note = #{note}, version = version + 1, updated_at = #{now} where id = #{id} and status in ('BORROWING', 'OVERDUE') and returned_at is null and version = #{version}
update borrow_record set status = 'OVERDUE', version = version + 1, updated_at = #{now} where status = 'BORROWING' and returned_at is null and due_at < #{now}
mapper.select: select id from borrow_record where status = 'BORROWING' and returned_at is null and due_at < #{now}
